request: Create modern geometric approaches in four or more dimensions using an agent swarm
review_scope: Refreshed public main, reviewed all 104 conclusion records and 14 continuation inputs, current instructions/status/board, missing-original ledger and prior geometric/operator scopes. Conclusion/dependency review only; no historical replay.

wall_check.label: Same open gap
wall_check.changed_input: None at entry. Formulate objects and assess construction/transfer obligations before admitting any research candidate.

workflow: Three proposal agents, then cyclic adversarial review; coordinator synthesizes and applies gate. Diverse starting points, not a claimed random sampling experiment.
budget: At most two proposals per lane and one review round. No automatic numerical scan, research row, manuscript version, thaw or external outreach. A later candidate needs a complete dependency edge and matched control before proof/certification.
success: One or more precisely specified arithmetic construction briefs with independent testable prerequisites, or documented rejection reasons. No success probability or novelty claim.
failure: If every construction still lacks its specified transfer, report that and retain freezes; do not manufacture a geometric positivity theorem.
evidence_gaps: Both historical original-evidence recovery groups remain OPEN.
